addressed.claim_id: Changed `_parse_income` to correctly reject inputs with more than 2 decimal places (e.g. "10.005", "1.001") by checking `amount.as_tuple().exponent < -2` instead of relying on `Decimal.quantize(CENT)` raising `InvalidOperation`, which with the default context silently rounds instead of raising. Normalization to 2 dp via `quantize(CENT)` now happens only after validation, preserving ROUND_HALF_UP exclusively for tax/rate calculations.
